agency: Colorado WIC (Dept. of Public Health and Environment)
description: Nutrition support, breastfeeding help, and food benefits for pregnant and postpartum people, infants, and children under 5. Referred applicants are contacted by WIC staff within 10 days; U.S. citizenship is not required.
eligibility: Colorado residents
Pregnant, postpartum, or breastfeeding, or a child under 5
Income guidelines apply — see program page

deadlines.note: Apply any time; staff contact referrals within 10 days.

Pregnant or caring for a child under 18
Qualifying immigration status
Income and resource criteria — see program page

name: Colorado Unemployment Insurance
agency: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment (CDLE)
description: Temporary wage replacement for workers who lost jobs through no fault of their own. File a claim online and certify regularly to keep receiving benefits.
eligibility: Colorado workers who lost work through no fault of their own and meet wage requirements — see program page

deadlines.note: File promptly after job loss; weekly certification required.

whatToBring: Employment history and wage information
